quest.title: Wayfarer's Whispers
quest.description: You are about to travel to the nation of snow, and Paimon seems to be sorting through all the photos you have taken along the way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, over here! Paimon's got something nice to show you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lookie look! Paimon took these pictures on our travels.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been to all sorts of places, and while you were busy exploring, Paimon was busy with her Kamera!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here, take a look at these photos Paimon masterfully took.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, do you remember the two photo albums we bought at Damoville Purveyor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course you do! Paimon spent all her savings to reserve those albums, even though it was way in advance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anywho, you took one of the albums, and Paimon took the other. That way, we'd match!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's already stuffed her album full of photos, but she's not sure if you've done the same yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But just in case, Paimon bought a new photo album, and although she was planning on keeping it as a backup, she'll give it to you if yours is full!

choices.text: Do you like taking pictures, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We've been to lots of places together, and seen so many pretty sights that ordinary folks might never even dream of!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It'd be a shame if Paimon didn't keep some mementos!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: More importantly! These are important memories for both of us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've gotta cherish our past memories and our future experiences. That's what Pacal told Paimon. Wise words, dontcha think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's gonna lend you her Kamera this time so you can take more pictures yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're about to journey to Snezhnaya, and Paimon has a feeling that things aren't going to be easy from here on out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So let's sort out all the experiences from our journey while we still can!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That way, no matter what troubles we run into in Snezhnaya, so long as we think of the moments we shared together, we're sure to be brave and keep moving forward!

choices.text: Classic Paimon. Always thinking about others.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, well, Paimon is Teyvat's best tour guide, she can't just think of herself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon bought an extra photo album because she really loves taking pictures!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've seen so many awesome sights during our travels, it'd be a shame if Paimon didn't keep some mementos!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, you don't? Paimon spent all her savings to reserve those albums, even though it was way in advance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it's fine! You're super busy all the time, so Paimon doesn't mind being a super tolerant travel companion!
